guarantees.claim: Each bit sp2v_sig[s*NumRegsKey+i] is driven continuously equal to key_init_we_ctrl[s][i] for all s in 0..NumSharesKey-1 and i in 0..NumRegsKey-1.

assumptions.claim: sp2v_sig is declared with a bit-width of at least NumSharesKey*NumRegsKey, so that all assigned indices are within bounds.
assumptions.risk: Out-of-bounds indexing causes synthesis/simulation errors or undriven bits if smaller width; extra undriven bits if larger.

assumptions.claim: key_init_we_ctrl is an array with first dimension NumSharesKey and second dimension NumRegsKey, each element a single bit.
assumptions.risk: Mismatched dimensions cause incorrect bit extraction or synthesis errors.

uncertain_points.claim: The linear address mapping (s*NumRegsKey + i) must match the consumption order expected by the downstream module receiving sp2v_sig; a mismatch could cause incorrect key init write enables.
uncertain_points.cond: When sp2v_sig is used to gate writes to key registers.
uncertain_points.risk: Key registers may be written out of expected order or share assignment, leading to key corruption or exposure.

uncertain_points.claim: NumSharesKey or NumRegsKey may be zero, causing the generate loops to execute zero times and leaving sp2v_sig entirely undriven.
uncertain_points.cond: If NumSharesKey==0 or NumRegsKey==0 at elaboration.
uncertain_points.risk: Undriven sp2v_sig may propagate X-unknown into key control logic.
